notes.title: ☀️ Solarpunk Demo is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We are putting all our energy into our main project, Solarpunk, and now it’s finally time: The Solarpunk demo is now playable on Steam! 🌞🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3465270

[b]What to expect in the demo:[/b]
✔️ Craft, farm, and build your own base on a floating island
✔️ A flexible building system to create your perfect home
✔️ Explore the skies with your airship and discover new places
✔️ Use sustainable energy sources like solar panels and wind turbines
✔️ Experience a dynamic weather system that affects gameplay

[h3]This is just the beginning![/h3]
The demo gives you a first taste of Solarpunk, but there’s much more to come! Multiplayer is still in development, and new features are on the way. Your feedback is incredibly valuable and helps us improve the game even further.

[h3]Try the demo and share your thoughts![/h3]
Give the demo a try and let us know what you think! You can share your feedback directly on Steam or in our [url=https://discord.gg/eu5srZ5RxU]Discord[/url].

Have fun exploring! 🌱✨

notes.title: Unbelievable Launch & First Updates!
notes.content:
[h3]Wow, we can hardly believe what’s happening! [/h3]

[b]A Game About Digging a Hole[/b] launched on Friday, and today, just a few days later, it has made it into the Top 30 on the Steam Charts! On Twitch, up to [b]60,000 viewers [/b]were watching simultaneously at its peak, and we are absolutely blown away.

A huge [b]THANK YOU [/b]to all of you! Your support and feedback mean everything to us.
We’ve been listening, and in the meantime, we’ve already made a few improvements:
[list]
FOV slider – You can now adjust the field of view
Motion blur toggle – Turn it off if you prefer a clearer image
Russian & Italian localization fixes – These are currently available in the test branch. To try them out, go to Settings > Betas and select the testing branch.
[/list]

Thanks again for being part of this wild ride! 🚀⛏️

notes.title: A Game About Digging a Hole – Now Available!
notes.content:
[h3]It's here – A Game About Digging a Hole is out now! 🛋️✨[/h3]

Over the past few days, we've been amazed by how well the game is being received on social media. Memes, clips, and comments show: You love digging holes! 🏭️ And the best part? It's just pure fun.

[h3]Why does this game even exist?[/h3]

Honestly? This wasn’t even planned.

Our artist, who primarily works on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805110/Solarpunk/]Solarpunk[/url], came up with this idea during their vacation. Instead of relaxing, they developed an entire game in just 14 days – entirely in their spare time.

[h3]What do you do in the game?[/h3]
⛏ Dig 🪓 → 💎 Find treasures → 💰 Sell treasures → ⚙️ Upgrade equipment → 🔥 Dig deeper → 🏰 Uncover the big secret

That’s what makes the game so exciting: simple, yet incredibly fun!

[h3]How you can support us[/h3]
[list]
💬 [b]Write a Steam review[/b] – Helps a lot to make the game more visible!
📢 Share clips & screenshots – Show the world how deep your hole is!
👀 Join the community – We’d love to see your ideas and… even deeper holes.
[/list]
Thank you for your support – now get digging! 🏭️⛏

notes.title: A Small Game About Digging, Treasures, and Secrets!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=P-Ys4PRZxsw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]How did „A Game About Digging a Hole“ come to be?[/h3]
Honestly, this wasn’t even planned. Our artist, who works on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805110/Solarpunk/]Solarpunk[/url], had an idea during his vacation. Instead of taking a break, he created this game entirely in his spare time – in just 14 days.

And in case you’re wondering: No, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805110/Solarpunk/]Solarpunk[/url] didn’t lose a single day of development time. Everything else, like marketing, is fully handled by the publisher.

[h3]Why digging?[/h3]
The idea actually came during the early development of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805110/Solarpunk/]Solarpunk[/url]. Back then, we experimented with voxel-based islands and terraforming. It looked cool, but for a small team like ours, it was just too much. So, we decided to scrap it – but the tech was still there.

Our artist, a big fan of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qLGcP4QbSV8]Motherload[/url], thought: “Why not combine the digging mechanic with randomly spawning ores and upgrade options for shovels?” And so, it began. Licensed assets, no long prototyping phases, and a fully functional game emerged in record time.

[h3]The Story: A garden. A treasure. What could go wrong?[/h3]
You see a sign: “House for sale – unbeatable price.” Sounds like a deal, right? Even better, they say there’s a treasure buried in the garden. Jackpot!

You buy the house, grab your “Super Mega Digger 3000 Ultimate 2.0,” and start digging. Your mission? Unearth the treasures and uncover the big secret hidden beneath. Sounds simple? Let’s see.

[h3]What do you actually do in the game?[/h3]
Dig 🪓 > Find treasures 💎 > Sell treasures 💰 > Upgrade your equipment ⚙️ > Dig deeper ⛏️ > Uncover the secret 🗝️

That’s the loop. And that’s exactly what makes the game so entertaining – it’s simple, yet incredibly fun.
